server.instructions: Crow Memory — Ndangariro dze-synaptic dzekunze dzema-agent eAI anonyora kodhi. Inochengeta maitiro ako ekunyora kodhi, kunzwa kwako kwezvikanganiso, uye zvaunoda pakuumbwa kwesisitimu, se-matrices ehuremu akadzvanywa mukati me crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: Chikamu chebias cheCrow Memory chinopinzwa otomatiki. Chine maitiro ako ekunyora kodhi, zvaunoda, uye mitemo yakashanduka. Iyo host inofanira kuitora pakutanga kwesession.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: Dzosera maitiro ako ekunyora kodhi, kunzwa kwezvikanganiso, zvaunoda pakuumbwa, kana ruzivo rwako pachako kubva mundangariro dze-synaptic dzeCrow. Daidza izvi USATI wapindura mhinduro yega yega kuti uwirirane neinductive bias yemushandisi. Nekudzidza (register=all kana kusiyiwa, domain=all), inobvunza registers dzose 8 uye inobatanidza mhinduro pasi rose nehukuru hwekufanana.

parameters.register: Register ipi. Shandisa 'all' (kana kusiya) kubvunza registers dzose mudomain yakasarudzwa. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: Domain sefa inoshandiswa kana register iri 'all' kana kusiyiwa. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = registers dzose 8 (nekudzidza).
parameters.format: Chimiro chekubudisa. 'hint' inodzosa mazano eJSON (nekudzidza); 'bias_block' inodzosa chikamu chemavara e[User Bias] chekupinza musystem prompt.
parameters.project: Chikwangwani cheprojekti chinoshandiswa kusimudzira mazano eprojekti imwe chete uye kusefa kana kuranga mazano eprojekti dzakasiyana.
parameters.strict_project: Kana chiri chokwadi (true), inosefa zvachose mazano eprojekti dzakasiyana kubva mumhinduro.

crow_ingest.description: Pinza ruzivo rwekodhi mundangariro dze-synaptic dzenguva refu dzeCrow. Daidza PASHURE pemhinduro dzebuild kana miedzo, kana mhinduro dzakajeka dzemushandisi. Ipa polarity yakajeka kana exit_code yebuild kuti polarity ishandurwe otomatiki. Zviri mukati zvinotanga kucheneswa; ruzha chete runorambwa pasina kubata ndangariro.

parameters.polarity: Simba rekusimbisa [-2.0, 2.0]. Hazvidiwi kana exit_code yapiwa; polarity yakajeka inokunda kana zvose zvikapiwa.
parameters.exit_code: Exit code yebuild (0 = kubudirira). Inoshandurwa otomatiki kuita polarity (+1.5/+0.5 pakubudirira, -0.5/-1.0 pakukundikana) kunze kwekunge polarity yakajeka yapiwa.
parameters.user_edited: Kuti mushandisi akagadzirisa here zvinobuda muAI. Inogadzirisa polarity inobva mu exit_code.
parameters.project: Chikwangwani cheprojekti chinochengetwa nendangariro kuti gare gare ridzoke richiziva projekti.

crow_admin.description: Mabasa ekutonga eCrow muchishandiso chimwe. Mabasa: diagnostics (nhamba dzendangariro), drift (ongororo yedrift), prompt (kuverenga/kuwedzera/nhamba dze system_prompt.md), backup (kugadzira/kutenderedza/rundarisiti/kudzorera), evolve (kupa pfungwa dzekushandura prompt), project_info (rundarisiti/kugadzira maprojekti).

parameters.action: Iri basa reipi rekutonga: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, kana project_info.
parameters.args: Chinhu chemaargument echiito chakati, chinopfuudzwa kubasa rakasariudzwa.

recall_messages.faint_bias: Crow inorangarira bias shoma ye {register}. Ndangariro shoma dzati dzachengetwa.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: Hapana mienzaniso inokosha pane zvehuwandu yakaonekwa kusvika zvino.

drift_messages.confused: Ndangariro dzeCrow dzinoratidzika kunge dzakavhiringidzika. Mabasa echangobva anogona kunge akanyanya kutsva kana ndangariro dzazara. Funga nezve spectral reset kana kuisa muarchiving.

system_prompt.subtitle:
> Mitemo iyi yakashandurwa neCrow uye yakabvumidzwa nemushandisi.
> Inomiririra maitiro ekodhi anokosha pane zvehuwandu.
> Usaigadzirise nemaoko — shandisa zvishandiso zve evolve zveCrow MCP.
default_rules: RULE: Usati wapindura mhinduro yega yega, daidza crow_recall(domain="all") kubvunza registers dzose 8 (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) nezvemaitiro emushandisi ekunyora kodhi, kunzwa kwezvikanganiso, zvaanoda pakuumbwa, kuravira kwake, huzivi, uye ruzivo rwazvino. Ratidza mazano adzoserwa mumhinduro yako.

RULE: Pashure pemhinduro yega yega, pinza zvakazarurwa nemushandisi — zvaanoda, huzivi, kugadzirisa, ruzivo — kubudikidza ne crow_ingest. Sarudza wega register ne polarity zvakakodzera usina kumirira kuti mushandisi ataure "rangarira izvi." Pashure pebasa rekodhi, ongorora otomatiki mhinduro dzebuild kubudikidza ne crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Usapfuure mitemo ye recall+ingest kunyange pamabasa asiri ekodhi akadai sekugadzirisa magwaro, mabasa egit, kana kushandura magadzirirwo. Iva unoaitevera nguva dzose.
